research_height.transfer_path: strictly prior official monthly supply-pressure state -> six-component lifecycle economics -> possible later whole-portfolio treatment question

central_question: Does the latest strictly prior initial-release New York Fed GSCPI value being above its natural zero baseline identify a materially favorable or adverse state for the frozen six-component portfolio?

why_now.origin: The active optimization whole-map comparison found no robust shared internal-formula successor. An outcome-free official-source audit then found that OFR FSI and market CMDI natural states were sparse, while GSCPI uniquely preserves monthly vintage columns and a natural zero baseline.
why_now.program_selection: Program 2 is selected for this one newly causal published-vintage object, not as an adjacent continuation of House recess, STLFSI4, VIX, rates, participation, gold-yen, CFTC, reserve or SLOOS work.
why_now.program_1: The broad dual-portfolio internal-formula lattice and its two Lab interaction clues are already closed and cannot be rescued.
why_now.program_3: Order, clock, session, pending and occupancy paths are closed or confounded and are not implicated by the new source.
why_now.program_4: No new causal held-position checkpoint was produced by the source audit.
why_now.program_5: Any implementation consequence would be portfolio risk, but the external state must first pass economics without opening sizing or allocation.
why_now.program_7: The question is economic, not another evidence-path or estimator audit.

official_source.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
official_source.publication_rule: At or shortly after 10:00 ET on the fourth business day of each month.
official_source.revision_boundary: Current GSCPI rows may be revised up to twelve months. Therefore only the last available observation inside each monthly vintage column is used; the current revised diagonal is never backfilled into earlier releases.
official_source.causal_boundary: A release is usable only when its official release date is strictly earlier than the lifecycle server date. Every same-release-date birth is excluded, which is conservative to the 10:00 ET timestamp.

frozen_state.above_normal: The latest strictly prior initial-release GSCPI value is greater than zero.
frozen_state.at_or_below_normal: The latest strictly prior initial-release GSCPI value is less than or equal to zero.
frozen_state.unavailable: No retained official release date is strictly earlier than the birth server date.
forbidden_rescues: current revised history, absolute magnitude, percentile, trend, change, persistence, rolling window or alternate lag
component, book, period, month, direction, event, symbol or 2026-only subgroup
OFR FSI, CMDI, STLFSI4, GSCPI subcomponent or another external series substitution

outcome_free_feasibility.design_correction_before_outcomes: P4 contains only eight at-or-below-normal births, including one US30 birth. It is frozen as descriptive and cannot vote in period breadth; primary economics are the three density-eligible periods. This is an outcome-free design correction, not a research failure.

lifecycle_reconstruction.ordering: Concatenate only the six pinned files in declared order and preserve source row order.
lifecycle_reconstruction.birth: OPEN for five market components and PASSIVE_FILL for Passive.
lifecycle_reconstruction.final: The next same-component CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE under strict alternation.
lifecycle_reconstruction.planned_risk: Positive planned_risk parsed from final detail.
lifecycle_reconstruction.stop: One only when final detail reason is DEAL_REASON_SL; otherwise zero for DEAL_REASON_EXPERT.
lifecycle_reconstruction.centered_outcomes: Within each component-period among mapped rows, subtract the all-state mean stressed_r and stop rate. ABOVE_NORMAL minus AT_OR_BELOW_NORMAL centered differences are primary.

requirements: All ten declared source and portfolio byte/hash pins pass.
The six files contain exactly 16,477 event rows, 2,233 births, 2,027 CLOSE and 206 EXTERNAL_CLOSE finals.
Strict alternation yields exactly 2,233 complete lifecycles, 206 stops, actual net +444.19 USD and 2x-cost stressed net +407.0477 USD.
State mapping yields exactly 972 ABOVE_NORMAL, 1,252 AT_OR_BELOW_NORMAL and 9 unavailable rows.
Every confirmatory period-book-state cell has at least 20 lifecycles and every pooled component-state cell has at least 15.

favorable_above_normal: Confirmatory pooled centered stressed_r effect is at least +0.10R.
Confirmatory pooled centered stop-rate effect is at most -0.05.
The concordant favorable direction appears in both books, at least two of three confirmatory periods and at least four of six components.
No confirmatory period contributes more than 60 percent and no component more than 45 percent of absolute stressed-R contrast.
adverse_above_normal: Confirmatory pooled centered stressed_r effect is at most -0.10R.
Confirmatory pooled centered stop-rate effect is at least +0.05.
The concordant adverse direction appears in both books, at least two of three confirmatory periods and at least four of six components.
No confirmatory period contributes more than 60 percent and no component more than 45 percent of absolute stressed-R contrast.

requirements: Absolute confirmatory pooled centered stressed_r effect is less than 0.05R.
Absolute confirmatory pooled centered stop-rate effect is less than 0.025.
Neither concordant direction appears in more than one confirmatory period or more than three components.

decision_translation.favorable_or_adverse: Retain one Lab-only nonautomatic whole-portfolio question. Because P4 lacks a natural comparator, this unit alone cannot create an Optimization candidate, MT5 escalation, sizing rule or Live authority.
decision_translation.no_field_or_ambiguous: Retain no seed and return to the optimization whole-map boundary.
decision_translation.invalid: Correct engineering or design faults before verdict; do not relabel them economic failure.
